== Summary ==
[[Tom Lischke]], from Decipher's Star Wars CCG "People Like You" page (1997), which introduced him as Decipher's new Rebel Base Leader. Photo: Decipher (photographer not credited). Cropped to remove the page's white frame.

Identification: the page's only portrait sits under the heading "Meet Tom Lischke, since January, our new Rebel Base Leader", beside his signature graphic (tlsig.jpg); the photo's file name is tomlpeople.jpg.
